FN-SLIEK88-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 259
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/10/2026
Senate Bill 259 as introduced could decrease the obligations of certain counties by an
undetermined amount dependent upon (1) the increase in the amount of compensation from
uniform increases provided to county officials, whose compensation, currently tied to another
state official's compensation, would no longer be eligible for uniform increases; and (2) the
amount of longevity and merit based compensation included in a former county official annual
base salary that would no longer be included as part of the base compensation of county officials
elected or appointed after July 1, 2025.
This bill would no longer prevent certain counties from increasing fees charged for certain
services in the probate office, which could increase receipts to those county general funds by an
undetermined amount dependent upon (1) the number of services provided for each fee that is
increased and (2) the difference in the increased fee amount for each service provided.
